description: Add permalink anchors to headings; activating one follows the fragment and copies the section URL

attributes.name: levels
attributes.description: Comma-separated heading levels to process, h1–h6 only (default: 'h2,h3'). Invalid tokens are ignored; changes are observed

attributes.name: data-label-anchor
attributes.description: Anchor accessible-name prefix; the anchor is named "<prefix> <heading text>" (default: 'Copy link to'). Observed

attributes.name: data-label-copied
attributes.description: Screen-reader announcement after the URL is copied (default: 'Link copied to clipboard')

events.name: heading-links:navigate
events.description: Fires when an anchor is activated (unmodified primary click or Enter), after the fragment navigation and before the clipboard write
events.detail: { id: string, url: string, heading: HTMLElement }

childAttributes.name: data-toc-ignore
childAttributes.description: Skip this heading (or every heading inside this element): no anchor, no generated id. Shared with page-toc
